requiredWording.text: The Service is for use by individual voters (natural persons) only. It is not for use by an organisation, and it is not for use by a foreign campaigner or foreign government.
Only the browser session that created a comparison can build or print a voting plan from it.
A shared link is read-only. A voting plan cannot be built from a link you receive — build your own comparison first.
a shared link does not expire and cannot be revoked or deactivated.
The authorisation particulars you type are held only on your device, in memory, for that print. They are never saved and never transmitted to National Digital or anyone else.
Once a contribution has been merged into the aggregate counts it cannot be identified, withdrawn or deleted, because no per-person record exists.
The federal electorate boundary maps are a separate matter with a separate licence.

Nothing in these terms excludes, restricts or modifies any consumer guarantee, right, remedy or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, restricted or modified, including under the Australian Consumer Law.

notes: Content-addressed hash registry for the Terms of Use. Each version records the SHA-256 of the canonical Terms body (scripts/check-terms.mjs extractTermsBody: the +page.svelte with <script>/<style> stripped and markup normalised). The guard fails closed if the current wording no longer hashes to the recorded value for currentVersion — a version's text cannot silently change. requiredWording binds the clauses the implemented design depends on so they cannot be removed. Bump apps/web/src/lib/terms/terms.ts TERMS_VERSION, surface it on the Terms page, then run `node scripts/check-terms.mjs --write` to add the new version's hash.
